title: CONNECT-IP Request Policy Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene for RFC 9484 request policy.
scope: This verification covers connect-ip token tunnel initiation, single-stream association, URI Template expansion before dispatch, required encryption modes, configured upstream forwarding, local IP-proxy action, proxy rejection permission, and client aborts on non-successful proxying responses.
preconditions: RFC 9484 URI Template validation and expansion helpers are trace-owned.
expected_result: The focused CONNECT-IP request policy tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9484 request-policy artifacts, generated triage reflects requirements 0025-0030 and 0041 as trace-clean, and diff hygiene passes.
status_summary: The RFC 9484 request policy surface is trace-owned and verified by focused local gates.
